project: 太阳活动周 AI 科学家

search_protocol.review_type: solar-cycle mechanism evidence plus AI-for-Science system design review
databases_and_sources: ADS/arXiv/PubMed/Springer pages surfaced by web search
Wilcox Solar Observatory public data page
Pi official repository and local provider documentation
Nature, ICLR/OpenReview, arXiv, and official GitHub repositories for AI-for-Science agents
query_concepts: solar cycle prediction polar field precursor
AI Scientist Co-Scientist agentic tree search
AI co-scientist hypothesis ranking proximity evolution meta-review
scientific agent tool registry provenance reproducibility benchmark
inclusion_rules: official data or API sources used by the system
review papers that define accepted solar-cycle prediction or dynamo framing
foundational papers for physical mechanism claims
papers supporting a specific hypothesis, limitation, or counter-evidence route
exclusion_rules: forum posts and SEO summaries not needed for scientific support
papers not connected to B3 long-cycle mechanisms
sources without a clear role in data, model, hypothesis, or API design
search_protocol.stopping_condition: Stop when every active scientific hypothesis has support, counter-evidence, and a next discriminating test, and every adopted agent capability has a primary paper or official repository plus a recorded reuse boundary.

sources.title: 挑战杯｜2026年度'揭榜挂帅'阿里云榜题
sources.key_claim: The work must expose API/frontend artifacts and demonstrate an AI Scientist loop using Qwen/Bailian or recommended model tooling.
sources.design_role: Defines deliverables, model route, and evaluation emphasis.
sources.limitation: Does not define the scientific method for B3.

sources.title: Co-Scientist: A multi-agent AI partner to accelerate research
sources.key_claim: Generation, reflection, ranking, evolution, and meta-review agents can structure scientific hypothesis work.
sources.design_role: Supports the multi-agent architecture, pairwise ranking, and model-assist separation.
sources.limitation: General scientific AI framework, not solar-cycle-specific.

sources.title: The AI Scientist: Towards Fully Automated Open-Ended Scientific Discovery
sources.key_claim: End-to-end scientific workflows can connect ideas, experiments, result visualization, and paper-style reporting.
sources.design_role: Supports run artifacts, experiment logs, and report generation.
sources.limitation: Primarily AI research automation, not observational solar physics.

sources.title: The AI Scientist-v2: Workshop-Level Automated Scientific Discovery via Agentic Tree Search
sources.key_claim: Agentic tree search and experiment management can support iterative scientific exploration.
sources.design_role: Supports future hypothesis-tree expansion and failed-node logging.
sources.limitation: Not a direct validation of solar-cycle hypotheses.

sources.title: SILSO Sunspot Number Version 2.0 data files
sources.key_claim: Provides long-running monthly, smoothed, and hemispheric sunspot-number products.
sources.design_role: Primary long-cycle series for cycle segmentation and morphology features.
sources.limitation: Hemispheric product begins much later than total sunspot-number series.

sources.title: NOAA SWPC Solar Cycle Progression
sources.key_claim: Observed and predicted solar-cycle products expose SSN and F10.7, with recent values and prediction boundaries.
sources.design_role: Supports F10.7 drift diagnostics and Cycle-26 overclaim guard.
sources.limitation: Prediction applies to current Cycle 25 product and must not be rebranded as Cycle 26 amplitude forecast.

sources.title: WSO Polar Field Observations - 1976-Present
sources.key_claim: Provides polar-field observations and low-pass filtered values suitable for precursor-style diagnostics.
sources.design_role: Primary data source for H1 polar precursor and low-order toy model.
sources.limitation: Only a few complete WSO-to-next-cycle pairs are available for long-cycle validation.

sources.title: Solar cycle prediction
sources.key_claim: Solar-cycle prediction methods can be grouped into precursor, model-based, and extrapolation approaches; polar-field precursors have performed well in recent cycles.
sources.design_role: Supports H1 framing and the claim boundary separating precursor constraints from operational forecasts.
sources.limitation: Review taxonomy does not provide enough data for Cycle 26 by itself.

sources.title: Dynamo models of the solar cycle
sources.key_claim: Solar-cycle modeling is a hydromagnetic dynamo problem with observational constraints and multiple regeneration mechanisms.
sources.design_role: Supports Babcock-Leighton mechanism language, H5 toy closure, and observation-model comparison.
sources.limitation: A contest toy model is only a surrogate and not a full MHD dynamo.

sources.title: The Topology of the Sun's Magnetic Field and the 22-Year Cycle
sources.key_claim: The solar magnetic cycle can be explained through magnetic-field topology and polarity reversal processes.
sources.design_role: Foundational support for Babcock-Leighton style precursor and poloidal-to-toroidal narrative.
sources.limitation: Foundational conceptual model, not a modern data pipeline.

sources.title: The Solar Cycle
sources.key_claim: The solar cycle has well-known morphology including Waldmeier effect, asymmetry, and long-cycle observational constraints.
sources.design_role: Supports H2 Waldmeier constraint and general B3 mechanism framing.
sources.limitation: Broad review; individual diagnostic thresholds still require project data.

sources.title: Is the F10.7cm - Sunspot Number relation linear and stable?
sources.key_claim: F10.7 and sunspot number are strongly correlated, but proxy relations can differ and stability must be checked.
sources.design_role: Supports H3 proxy-drift guard and phase/windowed regression.
sources.limitation: Proxy relation study does not directly infer internal dynamo states.

sources.title: The 10.7 cm solar radio flux (F10.7)
sources.key_claim: F10.7 is a long-running solar-activity index with measurement and calibration considerations.
sources.design_role: Supports F10.7 as useful proxy while preserving calibration caution.
sources.limitation: Index background paper, not a cycle-origin mechanism paper.

sources.title: DashScope OpenAI compatibility
sources.key_claim: Qwen models can be called through OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions with DashScope API key, base URL, and model name.
sources.design_role: Supports QwenAdapter and /api/model/status design.
sources.limitation: API documentation, not scientific evidence.

sources.title: Hemispheric Sunspot Numbers 1874-2020
sources.key_claim: A continuous monthly hemispheric series can extend the direct SILSO record before 1992 using calibrated reconstructed values.
sources.design_role: Supports E4 overlap calibration and long-horizon hemispheric asymmetry tests.
sources.limitation: Pre-1992 values are reconstructed and must not be treated as identical to direct SILSO measurements.

sources.title: Towards an AI co-scientist
sources.key_claim: Generation, Reflection, Ranking, Proximity, Evolution, and Meta-review can coordinate hypothesis work under scientist oversight.
sources.design_role: Supports portfolio generation, proximity clustering, order-balanced comparison, evolution, and meta-review.
sources.limitation: Pairwise or Elo ranking is prioritization, not scientific truth; no generally reusable full implementation was verified.

sources.title: An autonomous agent for hypothesis-driven biological research
sources.key_claim: A literature-to-hypothesis-to-experiment loop can use multiple independent analysis trajectories and update hypotheses from observed results.
sources.design_role: Supports multi-trajectory experiment review, negative-result retention, and feedback to hypotheses.
sources.limitation: Biology-specific tooling is not directly reusable for solar physics.

sources.title: Language agents achieve superhuman synthesis of scientific knowledge
sources.key_claim: Agentic retrieval can iteratively find, rank, and cite scientific evidence passages.
sources.design_role: Supports literature discovery, evidence passages, citation checking, and counter-evidence search.
sources.limitation: Discovery results remain non-claimable until entered into the verified evidence ledger.

sources.title: ToolUniverse
sources.key_claim: A compact discover-inspect-run interface can expose a large reviewed scientific tool registry without flooding the model context.
sources.design_role: Supports the five-tool compact protocol and backend capability registry.
sources.limitation: External APIs and databases retain their own licenses and cannot be imported wholesale.

sources.title: AstaBench: Rigorous Benchmarking of AI Agents for Scientific Research
sources.key_claim: Scientific agents should be evaluated with controlled tools, stepwise scoring, cost accounting, and explicit baselines.
sources.design_role: Supports per-Agent gold cases, tool traces, abstention credit, and ablation tests.
sources.limitation: Benchmark resources and sub-datasets require separate license review.

sources.title: Large Language Models Cannot Self-Correct Reasoning Yet
sources.key_claim: Intrinsic reflection without external feedback does not reliably improve reasoning.
sources.design_role: Requires every reflection or meta-review step to consume tests, evidence retrieval, statistics, or human feedback.
sources.limitation: The result is task- and model-dependent but supports a conservative design boundary.

hypothesis_links.claim: Cycle-26 confidence should be governed by polar-field precursor evidence, not by sunspot/F10.7 proxies alone.
counter_evidence: Only four complete WSO precursor pairs are available in the current pipeline.
Cycle 25/26 minimum-time polar field is not mature enough for a direct Cycle-26 amplitude forecast.
next_validation: Extend polar precursor evidence using NSO/SOLIS or polar faculae proxies.
Run leave-one-cycle-out tests after adding earlier polar-field proxies.

hypothesis_links.claim: The observed cycle morphology supports a Waldmeier-like nonlinear dynamo constraint.
counter_evidence: Morphology correlation is not causal proof.
Individual cycles can deviate from the trend.
next_validation: Compare with a low-order ODE or flux-transport surrogate.

hypothesis_links.claim: F10.7-to-sunspot relation drift should lower confidence in single-proxy forecasts.
counter_evidence: F10.7 remains a useful and strongly correlated solar activity index.
Recent NOAA data can be preliminary and should be rechecked after finalization.
next_validation: Stratify regression by cycle phase and activity level.

hypothesis_links.claim: North-south asymmetry is material evidence against a purely axisymmetric explanation.
counter_evidence: SILSO hemispheric coverage starts in 1992 and is short relative to total sunspot history.
Asymmetry can constrain models without uniquely identifying one mechanism.

hypothesis_links.claim: A low-order Babcock-Leighton closure can explain how polar-field precursor evidence becomes next-cycle amplitude evidence, but remains diagnostic under sparse WSO pairs.
counter_evidence: The fitted quenching parameter is underdetermined with four WSO pairs.
The toy map is not a full magnetohydrodynamic dynamo simulation.
next_validation: Compare the toy map with a low-order ODE or flux-transport surrogate.
